description: Adapter test feeds the real sparse NinjaOne alert shape and proves one mapped realm enriches organization while preserving order and other fields.
Adapter test proves explicit provider organization identity is preserved and excluded from fallback overwrite.
Adapter test proves missing, null, and multiple distinct realms remain unresolved.
DB-backed integration happy path creates and links a ticket for a fresh sparse alert mapped to an allowed organization.
DB-backed isolation guard proves identical device ids in another tenant or provider cannot enrich or create an organization-scoped ticket.
DB-backed forward-only guard proves a pre-existing active or acknowledged alert without a ticket remains skipped.
Redelivery test proves a newly handled alert creates no duplicate ticket and retains normal dedup semantics.
Focused regressions prove organization exclusions, first-match keyword/severity priority, maintenance suppression, and resolved retrigger behavior remain unchanged.
